hooks.command: output=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./gradlew compileJava spotlessCheck checkstyleMain checkstyleTest checkstyleIntTest pmdMain pmdTest pmdIntTest 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then reason=$(printf '%s' "$output" | tail -150); jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Pre-commit Gradle checks failed (compileJava, spotlessCheck, checkstyle*, pmd*):\n\n" + $reason)}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running compile, format check, Checkstyle, PMD before commit...
